title: Best Vouch Alternative in 2026
summary: See why Corgi is the best Vouch alternative for SaaS and AI startups: our AI options, online buying and customer results, plus how to compare quotes.
body_markdown:
Corgi gives you a direct way to buy protection for your software, data and leadership. We can help you choose the coverage and get it in place.


### Buy online, with help when you need it


Our


[online process](https://www.corgi.insure/) takes you through the application, quote review and payment. You can buy without scheduling a call. If you're unsure about a limit or a customer's insurance clause,


[bring us in](https://www.corgi.insure/book-a-demo) and we'll help you work through the coverage choices.


Eligible startup applications can receive


[quotes in under 10 minutes, with same-day binding possible](https://www.corgi.insure/startup-insurance) .


[Corgi's public self-serve buying section](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/4grxwvwe/production/449ccc896f8496a2e9e93145178bf9a73c586a69-1512x805.jpg)


Our self-serve buying section on the


[Corgi homepage](https://www.corgi.insure/) , captured October 22, 2026.


### Match the AI coverage to the product


An AI sales assistant, a lending model and an autonomous device don't create the same risks. Our


[AI and Algorithmic Liability Endorsement](https://www.corgi.insure/tech-eo) lets you select modules addressing areas such as:


- Hallucination and defamation.


- Algorithmic bias and discrimination.


- Training-data misuse and AI intellectual property.


- Data poisoning and adversarial attacks.


- Autonomous-AI bodily injury.


- Regulatory-investigation defense.


Each selected module has its own limit and retention—the amount your business pays before that coverage responds. Tell us what your product does and where a mistake could hurt a customer. Those details should drive the coverage you buy.


We also offer optional extensions for copyright and trademark claims, subcontracted technology services, and certain contract claims arising from covered wrongful acts. That contract extension excludes SLA credits and refunds, so it's worth bringing the actual customer requirements into the discussion.


### Cover the company alongside the software


Our


[startup coverage options](https://www.corgi.insure/startup-insurance) bring together General Liability, Tech E&O, Cyber and D&O. You can also arrange Media Liability, employment practices liability and Fiduciary Liability as the company grows.


Your first customer might ask for Tech E&O and Cyber. A funding round can bring board requirements. Hiring adds employment risks. We can help you arrange those policies together as the business changes.


[Get a Corgi quote](https://www.corgi.insure/get-insured) and compare it with your current program.
